data.title: Mon3tr · 花盆的去处
data.description: 她端着小花盆找到合适的窗台，确认不会挡路后，才放心地放下。
data.promptProse: Standing beside a sunlit windowsill in Kal'tsit's office, Mon3tr carefully holds a small terracotta plant pot with both hands, looking down at the green succulent as gentle morning sunlight illuminates the leaves and windowsill.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside a sunlit office windowsill, she cradles a small terracotta pot holding a green succulent in both hands and gazes down gently at its leaves. Crisp morning sunlight brightens the windowsill and foliage.
